block_row: [EXISTS, Minh] INT8 tile GEMM with TILE = 32. The load controller walks the loops n, m, k, row and reads one A word and one B word per cycle (one 256-bit word = one 32-element tile row); the PE array forms the outer product of a tile pair in 32 cycles; the accumulator sums the k partial tiles of one output tile. The three stages overlap at about 33 cycles per tile pair. In this architecture the B operand comes from bram_pp instead of the original internal B_bram.

frame_row: [EXISTS, Minh] INT8 tile GEMM with TILE = 32. The load controller walks the loops n, m, k, row and reads one A word and one B word per cycle (one 256-bit word = one 32-element tile row); the PE array forms the outer product of a tile pair in 32 cycles; the accumulator sums the k partial tiles of one output tile. The three stages overlap at about 33 cycles per tile pair. In this architecture the B operand comes from bram_pp instead of the original internal B_bram.

label: u_a_bram
(A_bram)
blocks.function: Activation buffer of 64 x 768 INT8 (1536 words of 256 bit, one word = one tile row). It is written only while the core is idle (load all, then start); 64 rows limit S unless the buffer grows.

label: u_load
(load_control)
blocks.function: Address generator and loop sequencer (n, m, k, row). Reads A and B words in parallel, 32 cycles per tile pair; because only one output tile is held, k is the innermost loop and every B word is re-read once per output row block.

label: u_pe
(Gemm)
blocks.function: 32 x 32 INT8 outer-product array: each cycle multiplies one A column vector by one B row vector and adds the products into a 32 x 32 partial tile; one tile pair takes 32 cycles.

label: u_accum
(Accumulate_control)
blocks.function: Adds the partial tiles over k into the output tile (bias would be added at the start of a new dot product) and emits the finished tile. Accumulator width needs at least 25 signed bits for K = 768 (open).

interfaces.name: Partial tile
interfaces.signals: pp_valid, pp_tile (32 x 32 partial sums), new_dotproduct

interfaces.name: BRAM read port
interfaces.signals: re, raddr[12:0], rd_done [pulse]; u_bram_pp -> u_load: dout[255:0], full[1:0]

interfaces.name: GEMM control (proposed group)
interfaces.signals: gemm_start [pulse], m_tiles, n_tiles, k_tiles, out_sel; u_load -> u_ctrl: gemm_done [pulse]

interfaces.name: Clock and reset
interfaces.signals: clk, rst (one clock domain assumed in v0)
